description.value:
Weapons are optional for most warriors — for followers of the Brawling Approach, they're beside the point. These berserkers have trained their fists, elbows, and whatever's lying around into instruments as lethal as any blade.

Stripped of armor and shields, they fight with pure, reckless abandon, turning grapples, throws, and bare-knuckle strikes into a brutal art form all their own.
